brand_reference: The three Caloric SVG wordmarks provided in Archive.zip.
method: SVG-native concept artwork; exact glyph paths reused where appropriate. No raster image generation or API used.
canvas: 1024 × 1024; opaque, square artwork. Rounded corners are only a presentation mask.

concepts.name: The Stamp
concepts.description: The exact C, oversized in ink on the original orange. Bold and immediate.

concepts.name: Bento
concepts.description: The C becomes a meal tray, with three blocks and a little food tucked inside.

concepts.name: One Bite
concepts.description: A little nibble turns the geometric letter into something edible and playful.

concepts.name: Daily Stack
concepts.description: Meal logs as a tactile stack of cards. Warm, useful, and a little collectible.

concepts.name: Amber Glass
concepts.description: A sculptural, glossy C with amber depth. The most iOS-inspired treatment.

concepts.name: Four Blocks
concepts.description: The first four letters of the supplied wordmark become a compact poster-like mark.
